{{Quote|What's going on?''"<br />"''The leader of the Sligo Pirate gang is going to race the Twi'lek!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Oollie]]|<ref name="AA" />}}
The '''Sligo Pirate gang''' was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] that resided in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point after [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], the leader of the gang challenged a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] to a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] through the tunnel of a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]]. After a few [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] there was an explosion, and the Twi'lek exited the tunnel victorious, with the Sligo Pirate leader limping out. The rest of the gang left aboard their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], leaving their former [[Chief/Legends|chief]].<ref name="AA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sligo Pirate gang first appeared in the young readers novel ''[[Anakin: Apprentice]]'', which was written by [[Marc Cerasini]] in [[2002]].<ref name="AA" />
